text: The project directly benefits over 1.6 million individuals in Buner and Shangla, with an investment intensity of approximately US$ 6 per beneficiary. It aims to operationalize early warning channels to reduce mortality and livelihood disruption during climate events. The installation of automated weather and hydrometeorological stations is expected to close observational gaps and improve the accuracy of flood and landslide warnings.

metadata.solution_name: SAP039: Integrated Climate Risk Management for Strengthened Resilience to Climate Change in Buner and Shangla Districts of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Province, Pakistan
